name: mouse-natural
purpose: iter-464 mouse cursor (docs/MOUSE_CURSOR.md 8), natural game (no mod: -Gates SR_MODS=0): the title's PRESS START by a click anywhere, the game's own LOAD A GAME? popup by hover + click, gameplay (cursor hidden), the pause menu by hover + click, AUDIO OPTIONS (slider drag), GAMEPLAY OPTIONS (toggle arrows), CONTROLLER OPTIONS (toggle), right click = back, RESUME by click, then the map (BACK key) and right click out. The very first PRESS START (before MAIN loads) stays a keyboard press. Every mouse action is confirmed by the game's own reaction ([APT_SCREEN] screen loads) or by the cursor's own [MOUSE_UI] press log. Stage coordinates (1280x720) from the AS inventory; the [MOUSE_UI] snapshot lines log the live item rects. Run with -Gates SR_MODS=0 -TimeoutSeconds 900.

steps.name: title-click
steps.purpose: Wake the cursor with a real move, then click anywhere = START (ScrPressStart.HandleInput).

steps.name: popup-visible
steps.purpose: The natural LOAD A GAME? popup; the snapshot logs its rows.

steps.name: popup-hover
steps.purpose: Hover the second row, then the first: focus follows with D-pad presses.

steps.name: popup-click-new
steps.purpose: Click row 0 = START NEW GAME (CROSS on button 0).

steps.name: gameplay-hidden
steps.purpose: In gameplay the cursor is hidden (no target screen): a move must log an inactive snapshot.

steps.name: pause-hover
steps.purpose: Wake + hover down the list (STATISTICS, MOVES LIST, AUDIO).

steps.name: audio-drag
steps.purpose: Drag the MUSIC slider from section 9 to section 3: LEFT presses until mCurrentValue = 3.

steps.name: audio-sfx-arrow
steps.purpose: Click the SFX slider's right arrow: focus SFX (DOWN), then one RIGHT.

steps.name: audio-back
steps.purpose: Right click = B: back to the pause menu.

steps.name: toggle-arrows
steps.purpose: Hover AUTO CENTER, click its right arrow, then the left arrow (value back).

steps.name: controller-toggle
steps.purpose: Click the CONFIG value: RIGHT (the toggle wraps), then back to the original with three more.

steps.name: resume
steps.purpose: Click RESUME GAME (btn1): the pause closes, the cursor hides.

steps.name: map
steps.purpose: BACK opens the map (a back-only surface: the cursor shows, right click leaves).
